title: Answer: space is a hologram of a one-dimensional spectral flow

statements.text: Space is not a passive container. It is an emergent, dynamic hologram generated by the discrete resonance of a fundamental one-dimensional oscillator, and dimensions are phase states of one spectral flow.

sources.locator: section "The Illusion of the Passive Stage"
sources.quote: They are dynamic phase states of a single, unified spectral flow.
